skill.description: Use when the user asks to "plan an influencer campaign", "build a campaign blueprint", or "launch a product with creators"; produces campaign objectives, platform and influencer-tier strategy, content requirements, a phased timeline, budget allocation, and KPI targets. Not for writing individual creator briefs — use brief-generator; not for the overall product-launch plan (tiering, calendar, press, community day) — use launch-tier-planner, which hands this skill the creator lane. A launch request that does not mention creators routes to the launch discipline, not here.

content.user_title: Plan Influencer Campaigns From Brief to KPI
content.value_statement: Influencer campaigns can drift when objectives, creators, budget, content needs, and KPIs are planned separately. This skill turns those inputs into a structured campaign blueprint with timelines, allocations, and measurement targets.
actual_capabilities: Defines SMART campaign objectives with success and failure criteria.
Selects platform roles and influencer tiers based on audience and goals.
Plans content deliverables, required elements, creative direction, and approval steps.
Builds phased campaign timelines from kickoff through reporting.
Allocates budget by category, influencer tier, platform, and efficiency target.
Sets primary KPIs, conversion metrics, benchmarks, and reporting cadence.
limitations: Does not discover live influencer profiles without user data or a connector.
Does not replace legal review for contracts, disclosures, or claims.
Does not write detailed individual creator briefs; it hands off to a brief tool.
Outputs depend on the accuracy of supplied budget, audience, and benchmark data.

use_cases.title: Launch a Creator-Led Product Campaign
use_cases.description: Build a launch plan that connects product positioning, creator mix, content requirements, timing, budget, and KPI targets.

use_cases.title: Turn a Budget Into an Influencer Plan
use_cases.description: Convert a fixed budget into tier allocation, platform split, deliverable volume, efficiency targets, and approval milestones.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Stakeholder-Ready Campaign Blueprint
use_cases.description: Create a structured plan that explains strategy, timeline, expected outcomes, risks, and next steps for internal review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Campaign Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an influencer campaign for [brand] promoting [product] to [audience] with a [budget] budget over [timeframe].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Product Launch With Creators
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a creator-led launch plan for [product]. Include objectives, platform strategy, creator tiers, deliverables, timeline, budget, KPIs, and risks.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Budget-Constrained Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an influencer campaign for [brand] with [budget]. Prioritize cost efficiency, tier mix, content volume, and measurable conversion goals.

prompt_templates.title: Restructure an Underperforming Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this campaign context: [details]. Rebuild the plan with sharper objectives, better creator criteria, revised budget split, and improved KPI tracking.

output_examples.input: A $50K sustainable sneaker launch for Gen Z on TikTok and Instagram.
output: SMART objective tied to launch awareness and tracked conversions.
Micro-heavy creator mix across TikTok and Instagram with budget allocation.
Seven-week timeline with content approval and reporting milestones.

output_examples.input: A seasonal beauty campaign with limited budget and strong UGC needs.
output: Nano and micro creator strategy focused on authentic product demonstrations.
Deliverable plan covering short video, story posts, usage rights, and disclosure needs.
Efficiency targets for engagement, content cost, and promo-code conversion.

output_examples.input: An always-on creator program that needs clearer performance reporting.
output: Monthly planning cadence with platform roles, content themes, and creator relationship types.
KPI dashboard outline covering reach, engagement, clicks, revenue, and ROAS.
Risk plan for creator churn, content delays, and weak attribution.

best_practices: Provide brand, product, audience, budget, timeline, and known constraints before running the skill.
Replace every placeholder with a real value before treating the plan as final.
Validate influencer costs, engagement benchmarks, and legal disclosure requirements before launch.
anti_patterns: Using the plan as a creator brief without adding individual deliverables and terms.
Setting goals without numeric targets, benchmarks, or failure definitions.
Choosing influencer tiers by follower count alone instead of audience fit and engagement quality.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces a full influencer campaign plan with objectives, strategy, creator mix, content needs, timeline, budget, KPIs, and risks.

faq.question: Can it find influencers for me?
faq.answer: It can define selection criteria and ideal profiles. Live influencer discovery requires supplied data or a separate discovery workflow.

faq.question: Can I use it for a product launch?
faq.answer: Yes, when the launch needs a creator or influencer lane. Broader launch planning should use a launch planning workflow.

faq.question: Does it create individual creator briefs?
faq.answer: No. It creates the campaign blueprint and then hands off to a brief-generation workflow for individual creator briefs.

faq.question: What inputs improve the output?
faq.answer: Brand details, audience profile, budget, timeline, platform preferences, past performance data, constraints, and approval requirements improve the plan.

faq.question: Does it work without integrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It can work from user-provided inputs, but connectors or past campaign data improve benchmarks and budget assumptions.
